newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Petronas Gas Islamic bonds rated P1 -RAM.
newsitem.headline: Petronas Gas Islamic bonds rated P1 -RAM.

text.p: Rating Agency Malaysia (RAM) announced on Monday it has assigned P1 rating to Petronas Gas Bhd's proposed 500 million ringgit Islamic notes issue.
It said it was a standalone short-term rating, reflecting Petronas Gas' processing and transmission monopoly in the high growth natural gas sector in Peninsular Malaysia.
The market risks were low with minimal construction and contract problems expected.
"The rating also reflects its extremely strong cash flow and very strong financial flexibility," RAM said.
Petronas Gas is a subsidiary of Malaysia's national oil company Petroliam Nasional (Petronas).
